about: Acceptance checklist, one entry per verifiable feature. Flip passes to true only after running its verify step. Never delete or reword an entry to make it pass; add a new one instead.

phases.title: Engineering process: traceable specs, evaluated features, one make entry point

features.description: Every developer command is a documented make target listed in docs/COMMANDS.md; CI and hooks call make
features.verify: go test ./tools/speccheck/ -run Commands passes, grep finds no scripts/ call in .github/workflows, and make init exits 0

features.description: make spec-check traces full-mode specs: EARS requirements with scenarios, named by tasks, covered by features, graded in a contract; cited ADRs and invariants exist
features.verify: go test ./tools/speccheck/ -run Spec has a failing and a passing case per rule, and make spec-check exits 0

features.description: ADRs with frontmatter are checked for status, date, deciders, two options and a Confirmation; the ADR index is generated
features.verify: go test ./tools/speccheck/ -run ADR passes, and make adr-index leaves docs/adr/README.md unchanged

features.description: make features rejects a new pass without PASS evidence, requires the evaluator for full-mode specs, and keeps the history rules
features.verify: go test ./tools/speccheck/ -run Features covers missing evidence, PASS evidence, self evidence in full and quick mode, and the three history rules

features.description: make evaluate runs the read-only evaluator in a fresh process and writes the evidence file; make review-contract reviews a contract
features.verify: make evaluate FEATURE=DEV-04 writes specs/007-engineering-process/evidence/DEV-04.md with a Verdict line

phases.title: Lint robustness: what passes the lint is what the reader sees

features.description: Lint measures every card, note and legend row against the width the renderer gives it, and card height against its content
features.verify: go test ./internal/lint/... fails a 420 px legend card on 'object reference, not traffic' and a 120 px legend card listing six kinds, and passes cards that fit

features.description: Lint reports zones, nodes, cards and notes that overlap the drawn header
features.verify: go test ./internal/lint/... fails a top zone at y 40 under a three-line meta, naming the zone, and passes the same zone below the header

features.description: Node text fits only with a safety margin, and sequence participant boxes are sized with it
features.verify: go test ./internal/lint/... ./internal/resolve/... covers the margin on both sides of the threshold and the two participant labels quoted in #72; their exported PNG shows one line each

features.description: Lint reports two distinct port badges that overlap on a node, naming both edges
features.verify: go test ./internal/lint/... fails the #73 repro naming both edges, and passes two connections sharing one port

features.description: An empty label shows its annotation badges alone; an annotation with no drawn target is an error unless the view hides it with a reason; hide_annotations hides badges
features.verify: go test ./internal/resolve/... ./internal/model/... resolves an empty label with G1 to the badge alone, fails an undrawn G1 and each bad hidden_annotations entry, passes an acknowledged one, and draws no badge under hide_annotations

features.description: A long zone sub no longer widens the title obstacle past the text drawn
features.verify: go test ./internal/lint/... ./internal/house/... leaves a lane 20 px right of a zone title with a 90-character sub free, and the obstacle equals the drawn text

features.description: Lint reports anything drawn past the canvas, and a landscape side column fits the canvas
features.verify: go test ./internal/lint/... ./internal/resolve/... fails a node past the canvas width, and resolves the #90 landscape with its side column inside the canvas and the lint green

features.description: Every example, regression fixture and docs diagram is lint-green under the new rules, fixed by changing diagrams only
features.verify: make examples exits 0 and the diff of internal/lint against origin/main removes or loosens no rule; the PR carries before/after PNGs of every changed example

features.description: tools/tokencost reads transcripts, and the ADR-0018 checkpoint on PAE is recorded with cost, recall and a decision
